title: The Pioneer Chain Primitive funds a chain-level incentive pool whose address is local but whose terms are set by the Core Atlas
content:
A.6.1.1.3.2.5.3.3.1 shows how thin a Pioneer Chain Instance is. Its identifiers reduce to one line — "Network: Solana" (A.6.1.1.3.2.5.3.3.1.1.1.1) — and its substance is a Pioneer Incentive Pool with an address on Solana (A.6.1.1.3.2.5.3.3.1.1.2.1). The rules are not written here: A.6.1.1.3.2.5.3.3.1.1.2.2 states that "the Pioneer Incentive Pool for this Instance is governed by the terms specified in A.2.2.9.3.1.4 - Pioneer Incentive Pool."

The division of labour is precise. The Agent contributes what only it can — a pool that exists at a specific address on a specific chain, backed by its own operational presence — while the conditions under which those funds may be spent stay in the Core Atlas, identical for every Agent that pioneers any chain.

That keeps a large discretionary pot from becoming an Agent-governed slush fund. Keel's tokenholders cannot loosen the pool's terms through a Root Edit, because the terms are not in Keel's Artifact; changing them requires moving the Core Atlas, where the Artifact Edit Restrictions bar Keel from reaching.

The corresponding weakness is opacity at the Agent level: reading Keel's Artifact tells you a chain-level pool exists and where it lives, but nothing about eligibility or size without following the upstream reference.
description: Keel's Solana Instance specifies only the network and a Pioneer Incentive Pool address; governance of the pool defers to A.2.2.9.3.1.4, so the Agent holds the funds without setting the rules.
